description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android application, outlining a method for outputting log data with related metadata.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a log node capable of outputting log messages to a target, allowing chaining of log nodes for complex logging behaviors.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to log a message with specified priority, tag, optional Throwable, and message, to be implemented by classes implementing LogNode.
